screen.title: Conversation: The career fair
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between two students.

audio.text: Are you going to the career fair on Thursday?
I want to, but I have a lab until three, and I heard most companies leave by four.
Actually, they extended the hours this year. It runs until six now, because so many students complained about class conflicts last year.
Really? Then I'll go straight after my lab. Do I need to print my résumé?
Bring a few copies. Some recruiters still prefer paper.

questions.stem: Why did the organizers change the fair's schedule?
options: The woman's lab was moved to Thursday.
Companies wanted more time to interview the students they met.
The building was not available in the morning.
Many students could not attend because of their classes.

questions.stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?
options: Bring printed copies of her résumé
Arrive before the companies leave at four
Email her résumé to the recruiters

why.en: Suggestion: "Bring a few copies". C relies on outdated information.
why.tr: Öneri: "Bring a few copies". C eski bilgiye dayanıyor.
why.es: Sugerencia: "Bring a few copies". C se basa en información desactualizada.
